heading.en: From a rate law to a clock

hook.en: A doctor needs to know how much of a drug is left in the blood after six hours. *Integrated rate equations* turn a rate law into concentration as a function of time.
hook.kn: ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ನಂತರ ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಔಷಧ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ಸಮಾಕಲಿತ ದರ ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳು ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾಲದ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Use the integrated equations for zero- and first-order reactions
Identify order from a linear plot

say.en: A doctor needs to know how much of a drug is left in the blood after six hours. Integrated rate equations turn a rate law into concentration as a function of time. In this lesson: Use the integrated equations for zero- and first-order reactions.
Identify order from a linear plot.

body.en: For a *zero-order* reaction the rate does not depend on concentration: −d[R]/dt = k. Integrating gives [R] = [R]₀ − kt, so [R] falls linearly with time. Examples: decomposition of NH₃ on a hot platinum surface at high pressure, and of HI on gold. The surface is fully covered, so adding more gas does not speed it up.
body.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ದರ ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ: [R] = [R]₀ − kt. ಉದಾ: ಬಿಸಿ ಪ್ಲಾಟಿನಂ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೋನಿಯಾದ ವಿಭಜನೆ.

narration.en: For a zero-order reaction the rate does not depend on concentration: −d[R]/dt = k. Integrating gives [R] = [R]₀ − kt, so [R] falls linearly with time. Examples: decomposition of NH₃ on a hot platinum surface at high pressure, and of HI on gold. The surface is fully covered, so adding more gas does not speed it up.

say.en: For a zero-order reaction the rate does not depend on concentration: -d[R]/dt equals k. Integrating gives [R] = [R] 0 - kt, so [R] falls linearly with time. Examples: decomposition of NH 3 on a hot platinum surface at high pressure, and of HI on gold. The surface is fully covered, so adding more gas does not speed it up. [R] vs t: straight line, slope -k.
say.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ದರ ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ: [R] = [R] 0 - kt. ಉದಾ: ಬಿಸಿ ಪ್ಲಾಟಿನಂ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೋನಿಯಾದ ವಿಭಜನೆ.

say.en: Completes in time [R] 0 over k.

title.en: On the board: integrated rate equations

say.en: For a zero-order reaction the concentration falls in a straight line with slope minus k.
For a first-order reaction, integrating gives ln R equals ln R zero minus k t.
So ln R against t is a straight line; that straight line is the test for first order.
Example: a first-order reaction is 80 percent complete in 40 minutes. 20 percent is left, so k is 2.303 over 40 times log 5.
For a gas-phase reaction A gives B plus C, followed by total pressure, the pressure of A is 2 p initial minus p total.
On the board: integrated rate equations.

title.en: Zero and first order: straight-line plots
title.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮ: ನೇರ ರೇಖಾ ನಕ್ಷೆ

narration.en: For zero order [R] = [R]₀ − kt, a straight line of [R] against t. For first order [R] = [R]₀ e^(−kt), so ln[R] against t is a straight line of slope −k. Switch the plot to find the straight line.
narration.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ [R] = [R]₀ − kt, [R]–t ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ln[R]–t ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ, ಇಳಿಜಾರು −k. ನಕ್ಷೆ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ ಹುಡುಕಿ.

caption.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ [R] = [R]₀ − kt, [R]–t ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ln[R]–t ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ, ಇಳಿಜಾರು −k. ನಕ್ಷೆ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ ಹುಡುಕಿ.

tryThis.en: Change [R]₀. Which half-life changes and which does not?
When does a zero-order reaction stop?

say.en: For zero order [R] = [R] 0 - kt, a straight line of [R] against t. For first order [R] = [R] 0 e^(-kt), so ln[R] against t is a straight line of slope -k. Switch the plot to find the straight line.
say.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ [R] = [R] 0 - kt, [R]-t ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ln[R]-t ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ, ಇಳಿಜಾರು -k. ನಕ್ಷೆ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ನೇರ ರೇಖೆ ಹುಡುಕಿ.

body.en: For a *first-order* reaction −d[R]/dt = k[R]. Integrating gives ln[R] = ln[R]₀ − kt, or k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). A plot of log[R] against t is a straight line with slope −k/2.303. Examples: decomposition of N₂O₅, hydrogenation of ethene, and all natural radioactive decay. For a gas-phase reaction A(g) → B(g) + C(g) followed by total pressure p_t, p_A = 2p_i − p_t.
body.kn: ಪ್ರಥಮ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). log[R] ಮತ್ತು t ನಡುವಿನ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಉದಾ: N₂O₅ ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕ್ಷಯ.

narration.en: For a first-order reaction −d[R]/dt = k[R]. Integrating gives ln[R] = ln[R]₀ − kt, or k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). A plot of log[R] against t is a straight line with slope −k/2.303. Examples: decomposition of N₂O₅, hydrogenation of ethene, and all natural radioactive decay. For a gas-phase reaction A(g) → B(g) + C(g) followed by total pressure pt, pA = 2pi − pt.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರಥಮ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). log[R] ಮತ್ತು t ನಡುವಿನ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಉದಾ: N₂O₅ ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕ್ಷಯ.

say.en: For a first-order reaction -d[R]/dt equals k[R]. Integrating gives ln[R] = ln[R] 0 - kt, or k equals (2.303 over t) log([R] 0/[R]). A plot of log[R] against t is a straight line with slope -k over 2.303. Examples: decomposition of N 2O 5, hydrogenation of ethene, and all natural radioactive decay. For a gas-phase reaction Ag gives Bg plus Cg followed by total pressure pt, pA equals 2pi - pt. log[R] vs t: slope -k over 2.303.
say.kn: ಪ್ರಥಮ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ k equals (2.303 over t) log([R] 0/[R]). log[R] ಮತ್ತು t ನಡುವಿನ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಉದಾ: N 2O 5 ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕ್ಷಯ.

say.en: Gas phase: k equals (2.303 over t) log[p i over (2p i - p t)].

caption.en: For a first-order reaction, log[R] against t is a straight line. Its slope is −k/2.303 and its intercept is log[R]₀.
caption.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ t ವಿರುದ್ಧ log[R] ಒಂದು ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಅದರ ಇಳಿಜಾರು −k/2.303, ಅಂತಃಖಂಡ log[R]₀.

tryThis.en: Make the slope steeper: that is a larger rate constant.
tryThis.kn: ಇಳಿಜಾರನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಡಿದಾಗಿಸಿ: ಅದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ದರ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ.

narration.en: For a first-order reaction, log[R] against t is a straight line. Its slope is −k/2.303 and its intercept is log[R]₀. Make the slope steeper: that is a larger rate constant. Compare with [R] against t for a zero-order reaction: also a straight line, with slope −k.
narration.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ t ವಿರುದ್ಧ log[R] ಒಂದು ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಅದರ ಇಳಿಜಾರು −k/2.303, ಅಂತಃಖಂಡ log[R]₀. ಇಳಿಜಾರನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಡಿದಾಗಿಸಿ: ಅದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ದರ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ. ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ t ವಿರುದ್ಧ [R] ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ: ಅದೂ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ, ಇಳಿಜಾರು −k.

say.en: I want to see what *changes*.

For a first-order reaction, log[R] against t is a straight line. Its slope is -k over 2.303 and its intercept is log[R] 0. Make the slope steeper: that is a larger rate constant. Compare with [R] against t for a zero-order reaction: also a straight line, with slope -k.
say.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ t ವಿರುದ್ಧ log[R] ಒಂದು ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಅದರ ಇಳಿಜಾರು -k over 2.303, ಅಂತಃಖಂಡ log[R] 0. ಇಳಿಜಾರನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಡಿದಾಗಿಸಿ: ಅದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ದರ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ. ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ t ವಿರುದ್ಧ [R] ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ: ಅದೂ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ, ಇಳಿಜಾರು -k.

problem.en: In a first-order reaction the concentration falls from 0.8 mol L⁻¹ to 0.2 mol L⁻¹ in 30 minutes. Find k.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. In a first-order reaction the concentration falls from 0.8 mol L⁻¹ to 0.2 mol L⁻¹ in 30 minutes. Find k.

say.en: Let us solve this together. In a first-order reaction the concentration falls from 0.8 moles L to the power minus 1 to 0.2 moles L to the power minus 1 in 30 minutes. Find k.
k equals (2.303 over t) log([R] 0/[R]) equals (2.303 over 30) log(0.8 over 0.2).
log 4 equals 0.602, so k equals 2.303 times 0.602/30.
k equals 0.0462 minutes to the power minus 1.
So the answer is k is approximately 0.0462 minutes to the power minus 1.

problem.en: A zero-order reaction has [R]₀ = 0.5 mol L⁻¹ and k = 0.01 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹. When will [R] be 0.2 mol L⁻¹, and when is the reaction complete?

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A zero-order reaction has [R]₀ = 0.5 mol L⁻¹ and k = 0.01 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹. When will [R] be 0.2 mol L⁻¹, and when is the reaction complete?

say.en: Let us solve this together. A zero-order reaction has [R] 0 equals 0.5 moles L to the power minus 1 and k equals 0.01 moles L to the power minus 1 s to the power minus 1. When will [R] be 0.2 moles L to the power minus 1, and when is the reaction complete?
t equals ([R] 0 - [R])/k equals 0.5 minus 0.2/0.01 equals 30 seconds.
Complete when [R] = 0: t equals 0.5 over 0.01 equals 50 seconds.
So the answer is 30 seconds; complete at 50 seconds.

say.en: Pause and solve this exam pattern question. A first-order reaction is 75 percent complete in 60 minutes. Its rate constant is.
k equals (2.303 over 60) log(100 over 25) equals (2.303 over 60)0.602 equals 0.0231 minutes to the power minus 1.
(75 percent means two half-lives, so t one half equals 30 minutes and k equals 0.693 over 30.).
